title: Tarick Mwambwa Chanaika v Zamanita Limited and Anor (APPEAL NO. 018/2013) [2024] ZMSC 5 (6 May 2024)
case_name: Tarick Mwambwa Chanaika v Zamanita Limited and Anor
outcome_detail: Appeal dismissed in its entirety; no merit found in any ground. Trial court's finding that appellant did not act in a higher capacity (no entitlement to acting allowance under clause 24.1 of contract) and that the claim for increased salary was unsubstantiated, upheld. A fundamental term such as salary cannot be varied through e-mail proposals; an express written amendment is required. Each party to bear own costs (matter from Industrial Relations Court).
